_note: Role -> capability overlay policy (contract/AUTH.md §11.5). Operator-tunable: edit these booleans (or point LEAF_ROLES_FILE at another file) to change what each role ADDS on top of the tenant's tier entitlements (entitlements.json). Read at request time by server/roles.py. ADDITIVE-ONLY: a role can only turn a capability ON, never off — denial stays the tier policy's job. Roles arrive on the verified `https://leafdesign.ai/roles` claim, minted by the Post-Login Action from Auth0-native role assignments (event.authorization.roles), the root-level app_metadata.leaf_roles array, and the leaf_admin flag (which implies platform_admin). `elevated_grants` apply ONLY when the verified subject is ALSO on the server-owned LEAF_PLATFORM_ADMIN_SUBJECTS allowlist (the W14 two-factor rule) — platform_customize must never appear under plain grants (freeze-gated). Role NAMES are operator-extensible: add an entry here and mint the matching claim; unknown names in a token are ignored. org_admin / org_member are RESERVED preset slots for the org-configuration phase and deliberately grant nothing yet.
